hacker-buffer-overflow-selected.head: fa98df63
hacker-buffer-overflow-selected.scope: Stock empty/ally/range refusal, actual 38 IS/2 s/30 s and 80-point 60-second reservation. Friendly Firewall 319 on the affected target was blocked without payment and succeeded after expiry.

targeting.source: GOB 395 is a selected hostile program with a stored range and ordinary viral test.
targeting.runtime: AbilityHandler preflights the loaded live opposing view, checks range and its spawn again on landing, and uses the common viral sight and deflection route.
targeting.test: StarterViralDebuffRequiresTheOriginalHostileSpawnAtLanding catches a respawn before the cast completes. Native PR857 sent reason 24 empty/ally, reason 34 at 15 m, and correctly landed on the living hostile at 2 m. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/857#issuecomment-7087570880

source-parity.source: GOB 395 stores an 80-point timed ability-buffer reservation, not a damage or resource effect.
source-parity.runtime: AbilityBuffBuffer reserves up to the available capacity and denies subsequent upgrades when the real occupancy budget is insufficient, using the disclosed local base capacity policy.
source-parity.test: The level-one target retains the 10-point 173 effect while 395 reserves 80 for exactly 60 seconds. The stock helper attempts the same 24-point 319 before and after expiry: first denied without payment and then accepted. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/857#issuecomment-7087570880

behavior-tests.source: The GOB sets 38 IS/2 s cast/30 s reuse and one 60 s reservation.
behavior-tests.runtime: Normal admission, timed effect and buffer logic share the same path for native and headless actors.
behavior-tests.test: HackerBufferOverflowMode replays retained 173/319 frames. The live helper console proof verifies no cost or reuse during the reservation and the normal helper payment/reuse afterward; stock PR857 independently confirms the refusal, debits, modifiers, expiry and lack of damage. The native run did not separately read the helper reuse frame. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/857#issuecomment-7087570880
